refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute the analytic extension of a real-valued signal.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: h = hilbert1(f) h = hilbert1(f, N) h = hilbert1(f, N, dim)

listitem.para: real-valued input signal. Can be a vector, matrix, or N-D array.
(optional) length of the Hilbert transform. Must be a positive integer.
(optional) dimension along which the Hilbert transform is applied. Must be a scalar.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Compute the analytic extension of a real-valued signal.

- h = hilbert1(f) computes the analytic signal of the real-valued input signal f. If f is a matrix, the transformation is applied to each column. For N-D arrays, the transformation is applied to the first non-singleton dimension. - real(h) contains the original signal f. - imag(h) contains the Hilbert transform of f. - hilbert1(f, N) computes the Hilbert transform with a length N. The result will also have length N. - hilbert1(f, [], dim) or hilbert1(f, N, dim) applies the transformation along the specified dimension.
